request.prompt:
WALDPOST CANONICAL ILLUSTRATION STYLE — waldpost-watercolour-pencil-v1

Use the supplied canonical animals.png and objects.png reference images as the authority for drawing technique. They show the predominant style of the current Waldpost gallery. Match their actual pixels, not an imagined style suggested by a filename.

Draw warm children's picture-book watercolour finished with visible coloured-pencil strokes. Use light, gently uneven washes, organic sepia contours, delicate hatching, softly irregular edges and modest drawn shading. Surfaces look painted and pencilled, with paper grain within the illustration. Keep the warmth of cream, honey brown, restrained sage and blue, while preserving every exact colour required by a task. Subjects remain friendly, recognizable and anatomically believable.

Do not turn the drawing into a 3D render, plush toy, clay or felt craft, photograph, glossy object, embossed surface or studio-lit miniature. Avoid deep ambient-occlusion shadows, inflated forms and realistic material microtexture. Do not mix in another illustration technique or use historical artwork as a style reference.

The role instructions below set the necessary detail and composition within this one style. Learning pictures retain fine drawn contours; small navigation symbols use the approved simpler, broader shapes and flat fills in the same palette. Keep the existing rendered game-character identities separate from image-generated learning subjects. Exact geometry and handwriting remain authored paths.

Preserve subject identity, counted quantities, exact answer colours and action differences. Use real alpha for isolated pictures and stationery, and an opaque canvas only when the selected role requires a scene or branding image. No accidental background, halo, visible grid, labels or extra objects.

ROLE: cartography
Apply the canonical watercolour/pencil medium as a simplified flat cartographic plan. Strict orthographic top-down projection throughout, no perspective, visible vertical surfaces, relief modelling or cast shadows. Use broad quiet colour regions, light washes, fine organic sepia outlines and a few small plan-view symbols. Keep path connections, water boundaries and relative landmark positions clear; remove decorative microdetail. Opaque landscape canvas. Geography references define layout only. The result is a design proposal outside runtime assets until approved.

ATTACH THESE ACTUAL IMAGE FILES IN THIS ORDER:
1. design/illustrations/references/watercolour-pencil-v1/animals.png — canonical-style: canonical drawing technique for animals; fixed majority-style pixels
2. design/illustrations/references/watercolour-pencil-v1/objects.png — canonical-style: canonical drawing technique for objects, leaves and flowers; fixed majority-style pixels
3. assets/forest-friends/world-map.webp — composition-only: actual geography, path topology, landmark locations and map extent only; repaint in the canonical medium

SUBJECT AND LAYOUT BRIEF:
Redraw the Waldpost woodland as a very clear, simplified TWO-DIMENSIONAL CARTOGRAPHIC MAP, LANDSCAPE THREE-TO-TWO. True orthographic top-down plan view: the camera points straight down at 90 degrees everywhere on the map. Every feature uses the same plan projection. Preserve the north-up extent, main path network, waterways and landmark locations of the supplied actual-world map. The previous painted proposal, if attached, supplies layout/content only and must be flattened and radically simplified. This is a design draft only.

Use broad, mostly flat pale sage/olive woodland areas, a pale open meadow at middle left, light blue water with a fine sepia bank outline, and continuous warm ochre paths. The routes and water must stand out immediately. Reduce decorative detail by at least 80 percent from the painted landscape proposal. Show forest cover mainly as a few large softly edged woodland patches, with a sparse scattering of small simple round or scalloped canopy symbols viewed directly from above. No individually drawn leaves, branches, trunks, roots, flowers, pebbles, reeds, grass blades or hundreds of miniature trees. Generous open space between routes and symbols. Keep the canonical watercolour/pencil character through faint uneven washes and soft sepia outlines, with extremely restrained paper texture.

Retain these geographic anchors, expressed as simple PLAN symbols rather than little scenic illustrations: mountain area upper right as a flat pale grey region with only three or four thin closed elevation contour lines and a tiny summit cross symbol; stream flowing from it through the small upper pool and the middle-right beaver pond, past the central crossing and into the southern wetland lake with a few simple island shapes. Bridges are short flat strips crossing water, viewed from above, without railings or arches. The fox's home tree just left of the central crossing is one slightly larger canopy circle with a tiny entrance/location mark, no visible trunk or door facade. Keep the main looping woodland paths, the western open meadow and small ring of six simple stone dots, a tiny red mushroom-cap location symbol above the meadow, sparse orchard dots, a tiny picnic-table footprint south-west of the home tree, and a small cave-location mark at the mountain edge. Any roof or landmark is a flat footprint viewed straight down.

Absolutely no oblique, isometric, tilted, bird's-eye landscape or side views. No upright pine silhouettes, visible tree trunks, building facades, vertical mountain faces, scenic snowy peak, horizon, light direction, cast shadows, relief rendering, bevels, dimensional shading or depth effects. Make it look like a practical, beautifully hand-painted hiking/park map, not a landscape painting viewed from a hill. Prioritize clear geographic areas, route connections and readable map symbols. Opaque full canvas on warm cream paper, with a narrow clean margin. No UI, player pins, character portraits, text, labels, title banner or decorative frame. This request produces a review image only and does not authorize replacing the runtime map.

STYLE PRIORITY: The brief changes subjects and layout only. Keep waldpost-watercolour-pencil-v1 and the supplied canonical reference technique throughout; do not import the style of a composition-only reference.

CURRENT EDIT TARGET: The FOURTH attachment is the previous painted map draft. Keep its recognizable geography and main connections only. Replace ALL oblique landscape drawings with flat TOP-DOWN PLAN symbols, and remove at least 80 percent of the small visual detail. The first two canonical images define only the warm watercolour/pencil medium, not the map projection. The third attachment defines the actual world layout. The requested result is a sparse flat map, with broad woodland patches, few canopy circles, clear continuous paths and blue water; never redraw the scenic perspective of either layout attachment.

note: Spacing/detail/projection proposal retained as input to a targeted correction of remaining side-view landmarks; not the final version 2 draft.
